fields.name: deal_value
fields.sql:
SELECT o.amount
FROM accounts a
JOIN opportunities o ON o.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.name = 'Mayer & Co'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM contacts c
    JOIN fetched_emails e
      ON (e.sender = c.email OR e.recipient = c.email)
    WHERE c.account_id = a.id
      AND (e.subject LIKE '%' || o.name || '%' OR e.body LIKE '%' || o.name || '%')
  )
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

WHERE a.name = 'Mayer & Co'

fields.sql:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.name
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN fetched_emails e
    ON (e.subject LIKE '%' || a.name || '%' OR e.body LIKE '%' || a.name || '%')
  WHERE a.type='Key Account'
    AND e.sender LIKE '%@atlas.com'
    AND e.recipient LIKE '%@atlas.com'
), upcoming AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.id, f.name
  FROM flagged f
  JOIN contacts c ON c.account_id = f.id
  JOIN fetched_events ev ON ev.attendees LIKE '%' || c.email || '%'
  WHERE ev.start_time > datetime('now')
)
SELECT name
FROM upcoming
ORDER BY name ASC
LIMIT 1;

fields.sql:
WITH key_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.region
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.type = 'Key Account'
), key_contacts AS (
  SELECT c.account_id, c.email
  FROM contacts c
  JOIN key_accounts ka ON ka.id = c.account_id
), last_emailed_account AS (
  SELECT kc.account_id, MAX(e.sent_at) AS last_email_at
  FROM key_contacts kc
  JOIN fetched_emails e
    ON e.sender = kc.email OR e.recipient = kc.email
  GROUP BY kc.account_id
), upcoming_meeting_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT kc.account_id
  FROM key_contacts kc
  JOIN fetched_events ev
    ON ev.attendees LIKE '%' || kc.email || '%'
  WHERE ev.start_time > datetime('now')
)
SELECT ka.region
FROM last_emailed_account lea
JOIN upcoming_meeting_accounts uma
  ON uma.account_id = lea.account_id
JOIN key_accounts ka
  ON ka.id = lea.account_id
ORDER BY lea.last_email_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
